title: Operador(a) de Logística
description:
O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência em recebimento, conferência, separação e movimentação de mercadorias.
  • Experiência no sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.
  • Desejável habilidade na administração de prioridades.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado, prática e permanente respeito aos procedimentos, normas e regras da empresa.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e feriados.
  • Orientação para a satisfação do cliente.

Como é o dia a dia de um(a) Operador(a) de Logística:

  • RECEPÇÃO DE MERCADORIAS:
    • Realiza a recepção quantitativa e qualitativa das mercadorias comercializadas e não comercializadas (equipamentos, materiais de escritório, etc), verificando e identificando o estado geral, fornecedor, metragem, referência, tonalidade, prazo de validade, etc.
    • Prepara o espaço físico e equipamentos necessários para a correta recepção, evitando a perda de produtividade na conferência.
    • Anota sobre o relatório de conferência tudo o que for relativo às mercadorias recebidas (quantidades, estado aparente, validades, etc), assegurando qualidade e prevenindo perdas.
    • Armazena as mercadorias no endereço de depósito correto, através da leitura da ficha da recepção buscando agilizar as futuras montagens dos pedidos de retira ou de entrega.
    • Etiqueta os produtos com código de barra ausente ou defeituoso e inserir as etiquetas de segurança nos produtos sensíveis a furtos, assegurando que as mercadorias entregues ao comércio estejam disponíveis para venda.
    • Separa as mercadorias seguindo a tipologia dos fluxos quanto a mercadorias de loja ou do depósito.
    • Libera as mercadorias para a armazenagem na Loja ou no Depósito, contatando a equipe de Reposição ou a de Armazenamento para efetuar a armazenagem (Cautela).
    • Realiza ações anti-demarcas através da checagem qualitativa e quantitativa rigorosa sobre as mercadorias recepcionadas, através de um bom fluxo de veículos no pátio da Recepção de Mercadorias e do correto manuseio dos equipamentos de movimentação (paleteiras, "gaiolas", etc).
    • Mantém organizado os equipamentos, ferramentas de trabalho e EPI’s (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual).
    • Realiza o empilhamento seguro dos paletes evitando prejuízos à bens e pessoas.
    • Mantém a área de recepção limpa e organizada ajudando a combater a demarca e prevenindo acidentes no trabalho.
    • Recebe as demarcas validadas pelo Comércio realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e colocando o produto demarcado no local de despejo.
    • Recebe as devoluções aos fornecedores, validadas pelo Comércio, realizando as conferências quali-quantitativas e agendando a coleta.
    • Recebe as remessas para Assistência Técnica, realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e agendando a coleta.
  • RETIRADA E ENTREGA EM DOMICÍLIO:
    • Efetua a separação do RSS (reserva sobre estoque), identificando os produtos e informando a separação para o setor comercial.
    • Realiza o endereçamento das mercadorias fazendo a reserva física de espaço e inventário rotativo com base na listagem dos produtos de RSS.
    • Efetua a entrega das mercadorias ao cliente, de forma ágil e cordial, colocando-as no veículo do cliente.
    • Separa e confere as mercadorias verificando todos os itens descritos no pedido emitido, disponibilizando-as para entrega a clientes no setor de retirada de mercadorias ou para transportadora (entrega em domicilio).
  • REPOSIÇÃO:
    • Repõe os produtos na loja de forma adequada.
  • GESTÃO DO ESTOQUE:
    • Armazena e garante a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos estoques.
    • Verifica diariamente os pedidos gerados pela área comercial, analisa a consistência de dados necessários no pedido (endereços, telefones, data entrega, referência, disponibilidade, etc), organizando a separação cronológica dos pedidos e liberando-os para faturamento.
    • Efetua atendimento telefônico informando os clientes sobre prazos de entrega.
    • Informa o Supervisor de Logística sobre eventuais problemas que envolvem a equipe de separação, operação e produtos.
    • Auxilia o Supervisor de Logística para o bom andamento dos endereçamentos do depósito (set-up, inventários rotativos, etc).
    • Efetua o tratamento diário dos pedidos cancelados de RSS.
    • Efetua o registro referente a demarcas de mercadorias apontadas na separação de mercadorias.
    • Tem bom relacionamento e atua como elo de contato com a transportadora terceirizada.
    • Juntamente com a equipe de SAC realiza o trabalho preventivo de possíveis problemas com mercadorias.
    • Informa ao Supervisor de Logística e/ou ao Gerente de Logística sobre eventuais ocorrências de problemas com mercadorias.
    • É referência no atendimento do Balcão de Retirada de Mercadorias.
    • É responsável pelos seus equipamentos de trabalho.
    • Respeita as normas de segurança.

Candidate-se para esta vaga e faça parte da nossa construção!

Desejamos boa sorte no seu processo!

Não deixe de visitar uma loja e conhecer ainda mais sobre como é fazer parte do nosso time, vendo de perto as pessoas que entregam as melhores experiências para nossos clientes.

Incentivamos a diversidade e a inclusão, por isso, todas as vagas estão disponíveis para Pessoas com Deficiências (PcD).

Sobre o Time:

O time de Novos Negócios é fundamental na identificação e exploração de oportunidades no mercado imobiliário. Este time é verdadeiramente multidisciplinar, colaborando estreitamente com as áreas de engenharia para avaliação de projetos, o departamento jurídico para garantir conformidade legal, a gestão comercial para identificar demandas do mercado, o marketing para promover os empreendimentos e a contabilidade para garantir a integridade financeira das operações. Juntos, eles formam uma equipe dinâmica e focada em impulsionar o crescimento e o sucesso dos investimentos imobiliários.


Main responsibilities

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Avaliar oportunidades de investimento em projetos imobiliários, considerando fatores como localização, demanda de mercado, potencial de valorização e outros aspectos relevantes;
  • Realizar análises financeiras detalhadas para determinar a viabilidade econômica de projetos imobiliários, levando em consideração orçamentos, fluxos de caixa, taxas de retorno e indicadores financeiros;

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia Civil, Engenharia de produção ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência prévia em análise de investimentos imobiliários, preferencialmente em empresas do setor financeiro, fundos de investimento imobiliário, incorporadoras ou consultorias imobiliárias;
  • Forte entendimento do mercado imobiliário, incluindo tendências, regulamentações e práticas de mercado;

  • Excel avançado para análise de dados e modelagem financeira;
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, priorizar tarefas e trabalhar sob pressão em um ambiente dinâmico.

Critérios que aumentam o match com a vaga:

  • Participação em processos de fusões e aquisições;

Job Description

Denodo is looking for a creative, focused, well-organized, and highly-motivated individual to drive their GSI Partner and Channel Sales. This individual will win, maintain, and expand relationships with channel, reseller, and systems integrator / consulting partners and is responsible for achieving sales, profitability, and partner recruitment objectives.

The role carries an Indirect / Influenced Sales quota and requires working closely with marketing to drive joint demand-generation and with Direct Sales colleagues in the field to accelerate opportunities through partners.

Operating at a strategic level, the candidate will help create new programs and incentives to grow partner ecosystem for sales and services that meet the needs of both partners and customers, so this position is not routine.

Job Responsibilities & Duties

Recruitment, Enablement, Development

  • Proactively recruits new qualifying partners
  • Establishes productive, professional relationships with key personnel in assigned partner accounts.
  • Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates partner needs, gaps and requirements to be successful on an ongoing basis.
  • Develop training materials, create presentations for resellers. Coordinate with other company teams to deliver adequate partner training for business and technical skills
  • Leads solution development efforts that best address end-user needs, while coordinating the involvement of all necessary company and partner personnel.

Partner Sales Planning and Execution

  • Proactively leads a joint partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship.
  • Coordinates the involvement of company personnel, including direct sales, marketing, support, services, and management resources, in order to meet partner performance objectives and partners’ expectations.
  • Meets assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned territory and partner accounts.
  • Depending on the territory may achieve revenue goals working in several sales models:
  • Direct territories: Generate opportunities through partners and connect with Denodo direct sales teams in those territories to consummate sale
  • Indirect-only territories: Sells through partner organizations to end users in coordination with partner sales resources.
  • VARs: Enable partner organizations to handle unassisted sales to end users
  • Build a strong partner pipeline through co-marketing programs, account and field mapping of company and partner sellers
  • Provide regular governance, reporting, and management of indirect and joint/co-selling activities

General Partner Management

  • Manages potential channel conflict with other firm sales channels by fostering excellent communication internally and externally, and through strict adherence to channel rules of engagement.
  • Ensures partner compliance with partner agreements.
  • Drives adoption of company programs among assigned partners
  • Monitors performance of partners and coaches them to higher levels of success.
  • Assist the overall business development team in developing good PRM systems, efficient partner workflows, company and partner performance reporting, partner marketing and support activities to enhance the partner program.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • BS/BA or higher degree
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience in a similar role with a strong focus on indirect sales and channel development for a software company.
  • Track record of results-oriented sales and partner management that sets and achieves metrics for partner recruiting, enablement, opportunity generation, revenue.
  • Excellent knowledge and experience of the workings of reseller, systems integrator and consulting ecosystem. Past relationships and network is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to interact with technical and business counterparts both within and outside the company.
  • Professional sales training would be an advantage but not essential.
  • Willingness to travel around 25-50%.
  • Be a team worker with a positive attitude.
  • Nice to have experience in leveraging Employee Advocacy and Social Media to network with industry peers, share thought leadership content, and enhance brand visibility to support sales engagement and relationship building.

title: Reservoir Engineer
description:
The position involves supporting all reservoir engineering activities, including oil and gas reserve estimation, production forecasting, reservoir simulation, and production optimization, while also demonstrating an understanding of geoscience concepts, drilling, completions, and production operations.

• Expert in integrated reservoir simulation studies, including data analysis and integration, model construction, history matching, calibration and predictions.

• Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both NPV and hydrocarbon recovery.

• Competent in the analysis of capillary pressure, relative permeability and PVT data.

• Competent in compositional reservoir modeling.

• Participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.

• Evaluates and initiates exploitation opportunities, including new drilling and work-overs to maximize reserves recovery and booking, and overall play economics.

• Prepare data and perform PTA interpretation and modeling.

• Formulate the strategies for reservoir development, data acquisition, field surveillance and monitor masterplans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.

• Extensive working knowledge of standard vendor applications for pre and post-processing of simulation data and Assisted History Matching software and workflows.

• Is familiar with field production activities to effectively implement reservoir management aspects during the field production phase, including liaison with regulatory agencies.

• Develop Life of Field production profiles and maintain auditable booked reserves estimates and reserves reports

• Coordinate and integrate data, simulation and studies between Artificial lift, production, and dynamic modeling to support the other areas.

• Work with the Production Engineer/Technologist to optimize well potentials.

• Write concise reports for all studies and maintain comprehensive, accessible and up-to-date records of input and interpreted data.

• Coordinates with the business development on acquisition and divestiture projects. Supports the reservoir engineering evaluation component of company acquisition


Education

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Petroleum Engineering.

• Long relevant experience may compensate for formal education

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience with reservoir engineering within the oil and gas industry.

• Reservoir engineering, reservoir management and reservoir simulation skills are essential.

• Proven track record in performing reservoir modeling and field development studies.

• Pressure transient analysis (PTA) interpretation experience will be a plus.
Knowledge

• High proficiency in any reservoir simulation software (Eclipse or T-Nav preferred)

• Proficiency in any production software like Pipesim and/or Prosper.

• Experience with any pressure transient analysis software like Kappa or Pansystem.

You will be responsible for assisting the Americas Region Workplace Experience Manager in all aspects of local operations management and program management within the scope of workplace experience as well as being the primary point of contact for the São Paulo Publishing Office and eSports Arena.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the overall inner-workings of the Riot office and arena. Partner with stakeholders such as local Riot leadership, building management, WE team, and Physical Security to develop and enact programs that maximize workplace effectiveness. Ensure the established budget is maintained and work to hold vendors accountable within budgetary constraints.
  • Manage local vendor and/or supplier relationships to ensure WE contractors perform day-to-day responsibilities and continue to meet Riot standards. Coordinate with on-site physical security as needed.
  • Monitor for and oversee maintenance and repairs, closely aligning with local and WE leadership. Monitor and improve office and arena environments to adhere to WE standards.
  • Partner with local leadership to drive effective Workplace Experience programs and provide insight on workplace needs.
  • Welcome visitors and out-of-town Rioters to the office. Allocate and log visitor passes to the office and help out-of-town Rioters with temporary badge access. Support creation of any workplace experience-related processes for the eSports arena.
  • Support space planning and workplace moves by collaborating with Rioters to understand their needs and executing necessary changes. Ensure the workspace is optimized to enable teams to operate effectively and deliver high value to our players.
  • Perform environmental health and safety (EHS) compliance activities and maintain and optimize office procedure documentation.
  • Support local office events and large-scale initiatives, including esports tournaments and cultural celebrations that reflect Brazilian holidays and traditions. Responsibilities include event planning, communications, vendor coordination, and on-site support to drive employee engagement and a strong sense of belonging.
  • Support regional operations, including recruiting coordination, employer branding and marketing initiatives, and managing travel logistics for local Rioters. This includes handling travel arrangements and collaborating with travel agencies to ensure smooth and cost-effective travel experiences.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience of providing facilities or maintenance service in a busy organization.
  • Experience managing contractors and suppliers, including monitoring service standards and ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures. Strong negotiation skills are essential for vendor management and contract discussions.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Brazilian labor law (CLT), particularly in adapting workplace practices to remain compliant.
  • Events management expertise with the ability to deliver high-quality, compliant experiences.
  • Strong work ethic with the ability to take initiative, function in a fast-paced working environment, with immediate and changing deadlines.
  • Ability to prioritize workload, with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and time management are a must.
  • Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to interact comfortably and effectively with managers and employees at all levels within our company.
  • Fluency in English
  • Ability to operate independently and proactively with little or no supervision.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Our Perks:

We offer medical, dental, and vision plans that cover you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children. Life insurance, parental leave, plus short-term and long-term disability coverage are also available. Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations. Balance between work and personal life is encouraged with open paid time off, and a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your personal relationship with games.

Because together we are better

It's our policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and members of Riot Games. We know that fresh and varied perspectives will make us better at what we do, so however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, we're excited to hear from you. Don't be discouraged if you feel you don't fully meet every single one of the requirements for a particular role, there's always room for growth at. Riot. If this role excites you and aligns with your passion for entertainment and live production, we’re eager to hear from you.

title: Data & Insights Manager
description:
Teads is the omnichannel outcomes platform for the open internet, driving full-funnel results for marketers across premium media. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, the combined company ensures value is driven with every media dollar by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement. One of the most scaled advertising platforms on the open internet, Teads is directly partnered with more than 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers globally. The company is headquartered in New York, with a global team of nearly 1,800 people in 36 countries.

Working very cross-functionally on an international scale, the Teads Data & Intelligence team is responsible for building solid data and measurement solutions for our clients to help deliver Teads media solutions and help determine their effectiveness.

In this role you will be balancing research projects for clients and agencies leveraging our measurement solutions and or working closely with sales to help build audience proposals using Teads data and insights tools. You will develop and maintain relationship with different research and data vendors ranging from Nielsen and Kantar Millward Brown to Retargetly and GWI.

You will be working across Teads’ diverse range of clients, spanning from tech to retail, from telecommunications to FMCG. We liaise daily with the Sales, Marketing, CX, Ad-Ops, Publishing and Studio teams.

The work environment is very informal and dynamic, perfect for a hands-on, proactive person who doesn’t shy away from picking up the phone or arranging a meeting to get the job done effectively.

The ideal candidate is proactive, has high standards of client service and a consultative solutions selling approach.

What will you do?

  • Lead data, insights and measurement efforts across the BR market.
  • Manage and allocate the research budget effectively throughout the fiscal year
  • Respond to request for brief (RFP) where data related solutions are required (most importantly, audience and contextual based solutions).
  • Coordinate and deliver on all required measurement and effectiveness studies and solutions in the BR market.
  • Address requests for information (RFI) where advertisers and or agencies are looking for data related questionnaires and when privacy, regulatory information is required.
  • Attend, present and advocate for Teads data and measurement solutions to client and agency partners in the BR.
  • Support BR sales and service teams on existing and new data and measurement solutions to aid in the sell, upsell and cross sell of Teads’ media products.
  • Partnering with local marketing and sales to promote Teads data solutions in the form of case studies, thought leadership, blog posts, insights generation and more.

What will you bring to the team?

  • Significant experience in the digital media and advertising industry.
  • Experience of programmatic media buying (and or selling). This involves understanding how media is bought and sold and where data is applied in the process.
  • Understanding and practical experience of the setup, activation, analysis and delivery of campaign measurement and effectiveness solutions (ranging from brand lift to attention)
  • Understanding of data solutions that include but aren’t limited to; audience (demographic, behavioural, interest) and contextual targeting and measurement principles. Additional knowledge of targeting options for CTV would be an advantage.
  • Experience working with first- and third-party data to develop audience targeting strategies and insights-driven recommendations.
  • Experience in working at any of the following: media agency, advertiser marketing team (with digital responsibilities), digital publisher, media owner (e.g. broadcaster) and/or digital marketing company (e.g. data vendor, DSP, SSP) to enable a strong understanding of the agency media buying process, including collaboration with strategists, planners, and activation teams.
  • You connect with our values:
    • Relentless Customer Focus: You put customers at the heart of everything, building strong relationships, understanding customers needs, and making decisions that keep their perspective front and center.
    • Act Today, Not Tomorrow: You make smart decisions quickly, prioritize action over perfection, and keep things moving forward, even when things aren’t 100% clear.
    • Obsess About Outcomes: You’re outcome-driven, take ownership of your results, and work through challenges to deliver what really matters.
    • Evolve Through Change: You’re adaptable, curious, and see change as a chance to learn and improve. You evolve your skills to keep up and push ahead.
    • Human-driven, Powered by AI: While we use AI to drive performance, it’s our people who make the real difference. You bring empathy, collaboration, and a love of learning to everything you do.

a Steck, acreditamos no poder do impacto. Ele inspira nossos colaboradores e colaboradoras a se tornarem agentes de transformação e embaixadores de uma visão compartilhada: sermos #IMPACTMAKER.

Hard Skills
  • Advanced proficiency in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads)

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced Sales Manager to join our team in Brazil, taking over an established role with responsibility for growing and maintaining our business in the region. You’ll work closely with regional leadership to develop and execute sales strategies, secure new projects, and deliver on revenue goals.

You will engage directly with Tier 1 network providers, broadcast operators, telcos, and content owners to deliver complex solutions for large-scale projects across live professional video delivery and primary distribution. The role includes international travel and calls for a consultative approach to ensure our solutions meet customers’ needs from concept to delivery.

Candidate profile
You’re a commercially driven sales professional with strong market knowledge and a proven track record of senior-level engagements. You’re comfortable managing the entire sales process, from initial discussions through to successful delivery. You build lasting relationships as a trusted advisor and have a service-minded approach to understanding your customers’ needs.

Key qualifications

  • 6+ years of business development or sales executive experience with proven results
  • Strong industry network and established relationships with key stakeholders
  • Enterprise sales experience in video compression, contribution, live production, OTT, or signal transport
  • Solid understanding of live video workflows for media and broadcast, including live linear channels, live event contribution, and OTT delivery
  • Confident in engaging with C-level clients in technical and commercial discussions
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish

Main responsibilities

  • Meet or exceed annual revenue targets aligned with global objectives
  • Work with the regional head to define and execute sales strategy
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline
  • Identify and pursue new clients and opportunities, mapping organisations and key influencers
  • Develop trusted-advisor relationships with key customers and partners
  • Collaborate with Technical Sales to deliver tailored materials and proposals
  • Prepare sales reports and accurate revenue forecasts, highlighting areas for improvement
  • Work cross-functionally to address customer needs, from product development to portal enhancements
  • Represent Appear at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings
  • Be available to travel as needed

Working at Appear
At Appear, you will enjoy an informal, inclusive, and collaborative environment with the energy of a growth-oriented company, where we value close collaboration with our customers and partners and offer the opportunity to work with world-class, cutting-edge technology. Be part of a growing global company and experience cross-cultural collaboration in a diverse and dynamic work environment, with over 30 different nationalities at our office today!

Application deadline: August 4th

Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, Appear is a leader in live production technology, specialising in high-capacity, sustainable solutions for media processing and content delivery. Our portfolio is designed to support the most complex scenarios of live event contribution, adapting seamlessly to the ever-evolving dynamics of the media, entertainment, and sports industries.

Our extensive client base, including world-leading content creators like NBCUniversal, Warner Bros. Discovery, Formula 1, NHL, and Riot Games, rely on our solutions to deliver the highest profile live media with utmost integrity and efficiency. This trust underscores our position at the pinnacle of live production technology, where our commitment to excellence and innovation meets the critical demands of the most prestigious live events worldwide.

Founded in 2004, Appear has established itself as a leader in the industry. Thanks to our world-renowned team of experts and their relentless emphasis on modularity and functional versatility, we are at the forefront of innovation in live production technology.

We actively participate with key industry bodies and technology partners to drive the advancement of standardisation and foster continuous innovation. Our excellence is internationally recognised through numerous accolades, including the prestigious NAB Excellence in Sustainability Award and TVBEurope’s Best in Market, celebrating our achievements in sustainability and technological leadership.

Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.

Our Mission is to recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. We love to promote from within - more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs - they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

Job Description

The Product Manager for Brazil is a strategic leader responsible for delivering innovative, scalable solutions that support business operations and enable business growth. This role provides vision, strategy, and roadmaps for Brazil’s systems, data, and technology needs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable value delivery. The PM collaborates closely with Brazil Product and Service teams, Brazil Leadership, Business Operations and IS to advocate for enterprise technology needs and consistent processes. By translating business requirements into actionable plans and fostering strong alignment between business and technical teams, the Product Manager drives continuous improvement and operational excellence. Ideal candidates will excel in aligning business strategy with technology development efforts, engaging stakeholders, and prioritizing work based on business value.

Successful Product Managers are expected to be strategic thinkers, strong communicators, and effective collaborators. They must balance customer and district needs with technical feasibility, prioritize based on business impact, and lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Strategic Systems Leadership

Provide vision, strategy, and roadmaps for systems, data, and technology needs across Brazil. Align product initiatives with business goals and ensure that development efforts deliver measurable value.

Collaborate with Brazil Product and Service teams and Brazil Leadership to drive strategic alignment and execution.

Serve as a key liaison between Brazil and Americas Product & Service teams. Advocate for enterprise technology needs and ensure Brazil’s systems and processes align with broader regional and global strategies. Partner with other Americas Product Managers to incorporate Brazil-specific needs and challenges into enterprise systems roadmaps.

Enable Technology Scalability

Champion consistent business processes across Brazil to enable scalable technology development. Help define and optimize workflows that support operational excellence and long-term system sustainability.

Business Engagement & Requirements Translation

Act as the voice of the district by engaging stakeholders to uncover needs and translate them into well-defined, actionable requirements. Facilitate continuous exploration and ensure that business priorities are clearly reflected in IS product backlogs and development plans.

Planning, Prioritization & Delivery Oversight

Define and maintain strategic roadmaps that contains the capabilities and features required for a successful operation. Prioritize initiatives based on business value and cost, and oversee release planning, adoption, and post-release enhancements.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including district teams, technical partners, and business leadership. Ensure transparency and alignment through regular communication and feedback loops. Share responsibility for overall solution delivery and employee satisfaction of our technology.

Support Agile process to accelerate value delivery. Provide development teams with clear requirements, business support and support iterative planning and execution. Collect and analyze user feedback and usage data to inform continuous improvement and innovation.

Third-Party Systems & Vendor Management

Own the roadmap and lifecycle of third-party systems supporting Brazil’s operations. Manage relationships with external service providers, ensuring alignment with business needs, performance expectations, and compliance standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Logistics, or a related field.

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.

Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications

  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines

title: Technical Purchaser
description:
This position is responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, ensuring adherence to Supply Chain procedures and alignment with project-specific requirements. The role involves managing the full procurement cycle — from requisition to delivery — while working closely with internal departments, suppliers, and logistics to guarantee timely, cost-effective, and compliant operations. It also includes contract negotiation, supplier performance management, and continuous contribution to process improvement and strategic sourcing initiatives.

  • Responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, in accordance with SC procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with BW Energy’s SC procedures and project-specific Procurement Plans.
  • Manage procurement, expediting, and supply chain control from requisition to onboard delivery.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders and logistics to optimize deliveries and minimize freight/customs costs.
  • Ensure quality and suitability of equipment/spares in coordination with relevant departments.
  • Apply thorough cost control throughout procurement activities.
  • Issue Purchase Orders in IFS and perform material receiving when required.
  • Monitor changes in the supplier market; maintain balanced contact with local and global suppliers.
  • Participate in supplier meetings and contribute to supplier relationship development.
  • Maintain commodity knowledge and oversee the development of the Bidders List.
  • Support implementation and understanding of frame agreements and identify needs for new agreements.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs.
  • Evaluate bids, perform clarifications, and negotiate with suppliers.
  • Analyze TCO / Life Cycle Costs and recommend awards.
  • Coordinate with Legal on contract terms and supplier qualifications.
  • Participate in the negotiation and implementation of strategic contracts (short, long-term or MSAs).
  • Monitor supplier production schedules and ensure delivery capability.
  • Identify and mitigate risks to delivery schedules.
  • Maintain IFS database accuracy; liaise quarterly with requisitioners to validate open requests.
  • Prepare regular Procurement Status Reports (PSR).
  • Ensure compliance with E&P policies, internal controls, and applicable tax regulations.
  • Guarantee the implementation of contracts for oil lifting operations.
  • Contribute to global SC initiatives and bid inputs for new contracts.
  • Support alignment of local SC practices with global best practices.
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and best practice adoption.
  • Ensure compliance with local content requirements.


Education

  • Education / degree within Purchasing and/or Logistics Administration will be preferred;
  • Long relevant experience may replace educational requirements.


Experience

  • Ideally, 8 years of working experience within purchase, preferably from Supply Chain within the oil & gas or marine related industry;
  • Previous experience with ERP systems.

Knowledge

  • In-depth knowledge of the local supply market for the oil & gas industry and general knowledge to the international oil & gas supplier market;
  • Familiar with the terminology of the oil & gas industry;
  • Good understanding/knowledge of ERP systems;
  • Technical knowledge/understanding of the oil & gas industry is an advantage.
  • Advanced English (oral and written);
  • Understanding and knowledge of the technical, contractual, and commercial issues related to the design and engineering of Floating, Production, Storage, and Offloading vessels is an advantage.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Regulatory Requirements
description:
About Nubank

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world.

Today, Nubank is a global company, with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo, by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit

About the team

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks, and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership.

GRC squad is responsible for collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to drive alignment between our technology security strategy and Nubank's overall objectives. We ensure that identified risks are mitigated, empowering risk-based decision-making by leadership both within and beyond the IT and Security Business Unit.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will:

  • Analyze and interpret new IT and Security regulatory requirements across various geolocations in which the company operates.
  • Stay up-to-date with regulatory changes and emerging trends, assessing their impact on IT and Security processes.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to design and implement solutions that ensure compliance with regulatory mandates.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation and internal policies, including regulatory impact assessments, project plans, and compliance reports.
  • Engage with cross-functional teams to provide guidance and expertise on regulatory requirements and compliance strategies.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities within the internal controls landscape.
  • Work closely with the Risk teams to align on mitigation of identified risks.
  • Prepare and present detailed reports on assessment findings, risks, and recommendations to senior management.
  • Work in a multidisciplinary and global team, interacting with teams mainly in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

We are looking for a professional who has:

  • Prior experience with internal controls, risk, and compliance initiatives.
  • Knowledge of international banking regulations and compliance standards, focusing on IT and Security requirements.
  • Experience in regulatory analysis, or a related field within the banking or financial services industry.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing compliance processes, coupled with a comprehensive understanding of the regulatory landscape, including but not limited to SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, SFC, Banxico, ANBIMA, SEC, and other relevant regulations.
  • Familiarity with diverse cybersecurity domains and concepts such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27k family, NIST, ITIL, COBIT and similar frameworks.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of articulating complex regulatory concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in technical assessment, with the ability to effectively collaborate with engineers, business process owners, and other stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency for both written and spoken communication.

Role Location

NWW

Benefits

  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Meal allowance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program
  • Gympass partnership
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • ‘Espaço Feijão’- Private nursing and breastfeeding spaces in our buildings
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nubank, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

title: Software Engineer, Integrations
description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic that’s had rapid growth since out of a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a hardworking team of talented individuals. Since our founding in 2021, we’ve gained customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps in 40+ countries and quickly approaching the #1 position in the industry.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact, being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s do the unimaginable - let’s make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It’s a sports team that’s hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

About the role

We’re looking for aPassionate, Communicative, and Client-Facing hands-on Integration Engineer to join our fast-growing engineering team at Topsort! This is not just another engineering role —here, you’ll have the opportunity to take full ownership of integrations, working directly withcustomers to shape how our cutting-edge retail media API solutions seamlessly connect with the world’s leading retailers, marketplaces, and delivery apps.

Key Responsabilities

  • Own the entire integration process – You won’t just be following instructions; you’ll beleading integrations end-to-end , solving complex challenges, and acting as atrusted technical advisor to our clients.
  • Be the bridge between tech & customer success – Work directly with clients, engineers, and product teams to deeply understand their needs andensure seamless API integrations . Your solutions won’t just be functional—they’ll be impactful and user-friendly, strengthening long-term customer relationships.
  • Solve real-world challenges with agility – Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize integrations fortop-tier retailers and marketplaces , ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently. Your quick thinking and hands-on problem-solving will directly enhance the client experience.
  • Build stronger client relationships – This isn’t just a technical role; you’ll be theface of our engineering team in APAC , helping customers navigate their integration journey. You’llown key client interactions , build trust, andbecome a go-to expert for their integration needs.
  • Experience the world – This role comes with international travel opportunities, allowing you towork directly with global clients , visit their offices, and immerse yourself in different cultures. If you enjoymeeting people, collaborating in person, and making an impact globally ,this is the role for you!
  • Build smarter tools & automation – Developinternal tools and frameworks to streamline and simplify integrations, making them more scalable and efficient for future clients.
  • Career Growth & Leadership – As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into a leadership role andpotentially build your own team in the future .

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Strong communication skills and experience interacting with customers and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in building integration tools and APIs.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, data formats (JSON, XML), and authentication methods (OAuth).
  • Preferred experience: Experience in SaaS integrations or ad tech. Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) tools and integration platforms.
  • Availability to work 4 days per week onsite at our Sao Paulo Office.

Topsort Culture

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. We thrive on working together, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

  • Direct and Speedy: we move quickly, experiment boldly, and get things done today, not tomorrow. Feedback is candid, and the drive for constant improvement is part of our DNA.
  • Ideas > Titles: We believe the best ideas win, regardless of who they come from. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it.
  • Embrace a Sports Team Mentality: We're only competitive externally, and very collaborative internally. Everyone plays a vital role, and together, we win as a team.
  • Silicon Valley to the World: Founded by Stanford and Harvard alumni during the pandemic, we offer flexible working arrangements and (at least) one in-person offsite gathering per year to stay connected as a team.

Topsort is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Página da Vaga | Banco de Talentos - Para Economistas
description:
Esse é um Banco de Talentos exclusivo para pessoas formadas em economia.

Estamos sempre em busca de talentos para enriquecer nossa equipe; a ideia é reunir talentos que façam sentindo para futuras oportunidades.

A posição de analista demanda boa capacidade de escrita e habilidades em desenvolver trabalhos analíticos, além de conhecimentos específicos de cada área da LCA, como estatística, econometria, microeconomia, macroeconomia, avaliação econômico-financeira.

Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, criatividade, liderança, proatividade, comprometimento, flexibilidade, colaboração, resiliência, curiosidade, capacidade analítica, diferentes perfis e investimos nas fortalezas individuais.

O preenchimento da futura vaga entre analista júnior, pleno ou sênior dependerá das experiências prévias, qualificações e perfil do(a) candidato(a).

As oportunidades poderão ser no formato híbrido ou remoto, conforme a necessidade de cada área.

Se você se identifica com a LCA, cadastre-se no nosso Banco de Talentos e lembre-se de manter o seu perfil atualizado. Fazemos uma triagem entre currículos cadastrados toda vez que uma vaga é aberta; reforçamos, porém, que alguns currículos podem acabar não sendo selecionados nessa triagem e a atualização do perfil também envolve a candidatura a vagas específicas.

Importante: por se tratar de um Banco de Talentos, não temos nenhuma previsão definitiva de quando a posição será aberta. Por isso, fique atento aos canais de comunicação.

A LCA é a maior consultoria econômica do Brasil. Atende clientes nacionais e internacionais nas áreas de finanças e em análises econômicas que envolvem regulação, políticas públicas, litígios, entre outros.

São aproximadamente 50 economistas, que atuam de forma integrada, agregando sinergias para o desenvolvimento de trabalhos de excelência.

Somos a única consultoria da América Latina ranqueada no Global Competition Review 100 e no Latin Lawyer 250.

Atribuímos o nosso sucesso à equipe, que une habilidades diversificadas e engajamento no trabalho em equipe.

O envolvimento em projetos é profundo, completo e imediato. O treinamento é na realidade. O ambiente é colaborativo, você sempre terá o suporte de todos.

Buscamos sempre construir um ótimo lugar para trabalhar e valorizamos o equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Respeitamos a individualidade e damos muita atenção a situações pessoais.

Atuamos pela diversidade e inclusão na LCA

A LCA valoriza a diversidade e incentiva a candidatura de pessoas que fazem parte dos grupos subrepresentados no mercado de trabalho: mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIA+, PCD e outros.

Desde setembro de 2021 temos um programa estruturado para promover a diversidade e um ambiente inclusivo. Temos atuado em governança, engajamento interno e atração e desenvolvimento de talentos com diversidade.

Promovemos conversas e palestras periódicas com pessoas convidadas de outras empresas e líderes de movimentos pro-diversidade.

Instituímos o Comitê de Inclusão e Diversidade que, aliado à alta direção, realizou o levantamento da situação das mulheres na LCA – que têm forte presença na liderança –; o censo de diversidade; e depois de um ano de programa, a pesquisa de inclusão e respeito pessoal e profissional.

Com base no que aprendemos, publicamos o Guia de boas práticas em respeito e inclusão, que você podeconsultar aqui .

Revimos nossas práticas de recrutamento e seleção com vistas a atrair e promover a diversidade. Estamos ativamente buscando pessoas não só de variadas características, como de diversas origens, formações e lugares de morada.

Nos primeiros doze meses do programa conseguimos contratar uma proporção três vezes maior de pessoas negras e LGBT em relação à média anterior – chegando a mais de 30% de representação de cada um desses grupos nas novas contratações.

Nossas pessoas pertencentes a grupos de diversidade recomendam a LCA para pessoas como elas trabalharem –veja aqui um resumo dos resultados da pesquisa. Estamos no começo, temos muito o que aprender e melhorar, e estes primeiros resultados só nos encorajam a seguir em frente.

O maior veículo de educação em Santa Catarina! Presente nas escolas municipais, a revista its Teens enriquece o dia a dia da comunidade escolar com conteúdos educativos e informações práticas do cotidiano.

Transformamos a paisagem urbana de Florianópolis com nossa mídia out of home que conecta marcas, histórias e pessoas de forma estratégica. Com 120 relógios espalhados entre a Ilha e o Continente, promovemos empresas, disseminamos informações e influenciamos turistas e moradores diariamente.

title: Bombeiros apagam incêndio na BR-262, o prenúncio da temporada do fogo
description:
Bombeiros apagam incêndio na BR-262, o prenúncio da temporada do fogo

Vegetação seca e o clima seco contribuem para o avanço rápido das chamas, o que dificulta o combate ao fogo

O Corpo de Bombeiros de Mato Grosso do Sul atendeu quatro ocorrências de incêndio em Corumbá nas últimas 24 horas, sinalizando o início da temporada de queimadas no estado. As ocorrências foram registradas em terrenos baldios, na região central e às margens da BR-262. Segundo o Inpe, o estado já registrou 87 focos de incêndio nos primeiros dez dias de julho, com Corumbá liderando em número de ocorrências. A vegetação seca e o clima árido contribuem para a rápida propagação das chamas, levando as autoridades a pedirem que a população evite queimadas.

Com a chegada do período de estiagem, o número de incêndios em vegetação voltou a preocupar em Mato Grosso do Sul. Nas últimas 24 horas, o Corpo de Bombeiros atendeu quatro ocorrências de fogo em áreas urbanas e rurais de Corumbá, distante 428 quilômetros de Campo Grande. A vegetação seca e o clima seco contribuem para o avanço rápido das chamas, o que dificulta o combate.

Conforme a corporação, as ocorrências foram registradas nos seguintes locais: na Rua Agostinho Mônaco, no Bairro Guaicurus (terreno baldio); na Rua Monte Castelo, no Bairro Aeroporto (terreno baldio); na Praça da República, região central (incêndio em amontoado de lixo próximo a um bambuzal); e na BR-262, no trecho do anel viário próximo ao aeroporto (fogo às margens da rodovia).

Os Bombeiros explicam que, neste período, a vegetação fica mais desidratada e inflamável, o que facilita que pequenos focos de fogo se transformem rapidamente em incêndios de média ou grande proporção. “O clima seco e o tipo de vegetação contribuem para a rápida propagação das chamas e dificultam a extinção”, alertam.

A corporação reforça o pedido para que a população evite a queima de lixo, entulho e restos de poda, prática que além de ilegal, pode provocar incêndios descontrolados e colocar vidas em risco.

De acordo com dados do Inpe (Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais), entre os dias 1º e 10 de julho, já foram registrados 87 focos de incêndio no Estado. O município com maior número de ocorrências é Corumbá, com 11 focos, seguido por Aquidauana e Coxim, com 8 cada, e Ribas do Rio Pardo, com 7. MS já está em estado de atenção devido à estiagem, que historicamente aumenta o risco de incêndios florestais, principalmente no Pantanal .

Nos próximos 10 dias, não há indicativo de chuvas significativas no Estado e a previsão é de baixos índices de umidade relativa do ar, entre 20% e 40%, segundo boletim divulgado pelo Imasul (Instituto de Meio Ambiente de Mato Grosso do Sul).

A estiagem, de acordo com o órgão, é decorrente da atuação de sistema de alta pressão atmosférica, que inibe a formação de nuvens e ocorrência de chuvas. A presença do ar seco favorece elevadas amplitudes térmicas, ou seja, grande diferença entre as temperaturas mínimas e máximas do dia, podendo atingir diferença de até 20 graus.

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.
The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.
Location: This is a Globally remote role
What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.
Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.
  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Regional Corporate Counsel
A Regional Corporate Counsel specializing in corporate transactional work to provide expert legal advice and support for Epson's Industrial line of business, including strategic initiatives. This role involves drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements, managing transactions, and advising on compliance and government regulations. This position will require building relationships with senior management to create appropriate legal strategies to advance the Epson’s business goals in the Latin American region.
Key Responsibilities
Transactional Support:

  • Provide legal counsel on all aspects of corporate transactions, including strategic business deals and government sales.
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a wide range of contracts and agreements, including customer sales agreements, distribution agreements, product lease agreements, loyalty program terms and conditions, master service agreements, NDAs, licensing agreements, policies and guidelines, release and consent forms.
  • Identify and manage legal risks associated with transactions and business operations, including government sales and bid transactions.
Advice And Counsel
  • Responsible for: managing an active portfolio of legal issues with respect to Epson Industrial products and services with moderate to high-risk implications and supporting the Company’s transactional requirements with tailored contracts.
  • Advise as to compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and policies within relevant areas.
  • Assesses legal risks and opportunities, establishes and advocates plans to minimize risks at levels acceptable to businesses supported.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external counsel, and provide training to internal clients as needed.
  • Shapes and advocates company’s positions to internal and external audiences regarding a variety of legal and business matters.
  • Coordinates efforts with internal and/or external legal and business experts when appropriate.
  • Communicates business risk tolerance to outside counsel to effect best outcomes.
Relationship Management
  • Advises Legal department managers regarding local laws, regulations and issues and provides recommendations on problematic conditions that require escalation.
  • Collaborates with Key Customers and EAI mid- to senior management across various parts of the organization, with emphasis on support for those involved with 1) Industrial Sales and Marketing, 2) Finance, Tax, Import/Export, and 3) EAI and Seiko Epson Legal/Compliance.
  • Builds strong relationships with peers and senior management to best meet company goals and objectives.
Department Management
  • Operates within budgetary constraints.
  • Develops and maintains written departmental standards and procedures.
Reports to: Assistant General Counsel (Epson America)
Language: Portuguese, English and Spanish
Legal Expertise
  • A Juris Doctor (JD) degree and admission to the bar (or Brazilian equivalent).
  • Several years of experience in a large law firm (preferred) and at a multinational corporation (required).
  • Proven experience in corporate transactions, contracts, and other commercial deals.
  • Strong negotiation and drafting skills, with the ability to effectively communicate legal concepts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to handle complex legal issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

title: Co-founder técnico - Novas Teses Talentum
description:
️ Essa vaga é para as novas teses da Talentum. Focada em empresas que estão em fase de pré-criação e que serão lançadas em breve. Se você sonha em construir uma empresa B2B e SaaS do zero, queremos conversar com você!
Procuramos pessoas que tenham o potencial e o desejo de se tornarem um Cofundador(a) técnico hands-on em uma startup nascente. Reconhecemos que a experiência e o conhecimento para essa construção pode vir de diversas fontes, pois não há uma trajetória única por trás de jornadas bem-sucedidas de empreendedorismo.
️Abaixo, estão alguns dos caminhos que, se você viveu, indicam uma chance mais alta de alinhamento ao que buscamos, cada um com seu diferente nível de experiência e potencial.

  • Experiência empreendedora prévia: ter (co)fundado uma empresa real, que independente do seu sucesso, conseguiu construir um produto, gerar algumas vendas e reter clientes.
  • Experiência em startups de alto crescimento: ter feito parte do time fundador e/ou time inicial de uma startup que viveu uma jornada de alto crescimento, entre as fases mercadologicamente marcadas como "Pré-seed" a "Series B".
  • ️ Experiência em Big Techs: ter trabalhado em funções de alto impacto (técnicas ou gerenciais) em empresas de tecnologia de ponta.
  • Experiência em consultorias: ter trabalhado pelo menos 2 anos em uma empresa de consultoria de referência.
  • Experiência como liderança: ter liderado pessoas em algum nível (colaboradores individuais ou líderes) durante a jornada.
  • Início de carreira com disposição ao generalismo: pessoas com alto potencial e intensa motivação, com visão sistêmica, mas sem conexões com capital.
️Essa não é uma lista exaustiva de requisitos. Nossa principal busca é por pessoas com intensa motivação e dispostas a viver a jornada empreendedora, com todos os sacrifícios que ela envolve.
️ Procuramos pessoas para empreender, e não colaboradores individuais — portanto, é preciso ter disposição para viver os altos e baixos da jornada early stage, e, independente da função executiva, fazer o que for preciso para a empresa prosperar, desde papéis estratégicos até os operacionais.
Os Diferenciais Da Talentum
A Talentum atua como um Co-fundador ativo e mão-na-massa, além de ser o primeiro investidor. Trazemos vantagens competitivas únicas, que empresas nascidas sozinhas não têm:
  • Contamos com um time qualificado e multidisciplinar para construir junto com você. Atuamos lado a lado desde o início, com especialistas em tecnologia, jurídico, backoffice, financeiro, relacionamento com investidores e vendas. Oferecemos suporte estratégico e operacional para acelerar o desenvolvimento do negócio de forma sólida e conectada com o mercado.
  • Temos playbooks que detalham cada passo da operação de uma empresa nascente.
  • Acessamos uma rede de mentores experientes: sempre que desafios complexos surgem, temos à nossa disposição uma rede de mentores experientes da indústria para auxiliar na discussão, guiando os empreendedores para a solução do problema.
  • Somos os primeiros investidores da empresa: com nossa injeção de caixa, suportamos a operação da empresa durante os momentos iniciais, para que os fundadores possam buscar as primeiras fontes de receita enquanto constroem seus mínimos produtos viáveis e suas operações.
  • Boilerplate de tecnologia: você contará com um boilerplate + design system robusto disponibilizado pela Talentum, para acelerar o desenvolvimento dos produtos.

  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs e SLAs).

  • Conhecimento prático em Cloud Connect, redes híbridas e integração entre ambientes.

  • Familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), CI/CD, contêiner, ferramentas de automação e monitoramento.

description:
Attaché de coopération universitaire (F/H) - Ambassade de France au Brésil / Service de coopération et d'action culturelle / Antenne de São Paulo

Join to apply for the Attaché de coopération universitaire (F/H) role at Ministère des Affaires étrangères français .

Description synthétique du poste

Sous l’autorité du Conseiller de coopération et d’action culturelle (COCAC) et de la COCAC-adjointe, qui pilote le secteur science/technologie/universités, vous exercerez la coordination et participerez au pilotage stratégique, administratif et financier d’un opérateur de l'action extérieure, Campus France Brésil, afin de contribuer à la gestion et à la performance de l'organisation. Vous participerez également à la coopération universitaire, tant au niveau national qu'au niveau de la circonscription consulaire de São Paulo.

Activités principales

Les missions se déclinent comme suit :

  • Direction Campus France Brésil (75%)
  • Coordination de l’équipe dans ses missions de gestion de la procédure « études en France » et de promotion des études en France, sous l’autorité du COCAC et du COCAC adjoint. L’équipe comprend : 1 VIA, 4 ADL à São Paulo (administration, gestion, finance ; promotion et communication ; informatique et support technique ; plateforme Etudes en France et dossiers étudiants), ainsi que 5 ADL responsables d’espaces Campus France (2 à São Paulo, 3 dans les antennes de Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Recife). Les missions incluent l'élaboration du budget, la supervision des services, la coordination des activités promotionnelles, la gestion du réseau des espaces Campus France, le suivi des tableaux de bord, la participation aux événements et la création d’un réseau de partenaires brésiliens et français.
  • Actions de coopération universitaire (25%)
  • En soutien à la direction de Campus France, vous aiderez au développement de programmes de mobilité, à la co-construction de programmes de bourses, à la veille stratégique sur de nouveaux programmes de coopération, et à la diffusion d’informations sur la coopération universitaire franco-brésilienne, en coordination avec l’attachée scientifique et technique de la circonscription de São Paulo.

Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée

Master ou Doctorat, avec une connaissance approfondie du système de l’enseignement supérieur en France, notamment en relations internationales. Expérience confirmée en promotion internationale de l’enseignement supérieur et en montage de projets de coopération universitaire, en France ou à l’étranger, avec une capacité à gérer une équipe dans un environnement international.
